decision_conditions: The amendment sought is not considered as non materials, because the alterations to the scheme necessitates further assessment with respect to the impact upon the amenities of adjoining occupiers with respect to loss of privacy and potential over looking. Further, it would appear that there are other variations to the scheme in terms of increased in the height of the rear projection and the building itself. All such variations are considered to be materially different from the approved scheme thereby requiring the submission of new application.
description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref:P1131.24 dated 04/12/2024 to allow for alterations to fenestration (Demolition of the main building (Retrospective) to allow for further reinforcement of the existing foundation, and minor internal alterations and construction of a new dwelling)
